title: ConvNeXt V2: Co-designing and Scaling ConvNets with Masked Autoencoders
mechanism: Fully convolutional masked autoencoder (sparse conv on visible patches) plus GRN layer, so ConvNets gain from masked image modeling.
adaptation: On the de-duplicated pool, 1-ch stem, 512 px random crops without rescaling: (a) continue FCMAE from ImageNet V2-Nano/Tiny; (b) from-scratch FCMAE on Pico/Nano as in the SEM paper. Mask 0.5, 32 px patches. Encoder in smp U-Net++ with a stride-2 skip, PF fine-tune.
min_experiment: Arm A continued FCMAE V2-Nano on 11.9k (~40 GPU-h) and arm B from-scratch Pico/Nano; baseline = same backbone with ImageNet weights under PF. Metrics: out-of-fold crack relF1@2 (cv5v2), E1 crack recall, inactive IoU, 2 seeds. Kill if all three below +0.01.
evidence: R: FCMAE lets ConvNeXt V2 gain from MIM on ImageNet/ADE20K; in-domain evidence comes from the SEM paper (+0.8 to +5.9 AJI+ over ImageNet on 25k greyscale images).
prior_overlap: Partial: our SparK MIM on ResNet-34 (11.9k, PF, 100% labels) was n.d. ConvNeXt V2 backbone, FCMAE recipe and from-scratch in-domain training are untested, still open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Continue FCMAE from ImageNet ConvNeXt V2-N/T on the de-duplicated pool, 1-ch stem, 512 px, mask 0.5 on 16 px patches (finer than our 32 px). Encoder into smp U-Net++ with an added stride-2 skip; PF fine-tune.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: ConvNeXt V2-T U-Net++ init from continued FCMAE, PF. Baseline: ConvNeXt V2-T ImageNet FCMAE+FT weights, PF, same steps. Metrics: out-of-fold crack relF1@2, E1 crack recall, inactive IoU, 2 seeds x 5 folds. Kill if all < +0.01.
